title: Skye Games
description: Skye Games is a custom Minecraft project that combines several modes and mechanics into one server. It features Battle Royale arenas, an RPG system with progression and exploration, and PvP with custom tiers. The server also hosts unique events such as Mob
body: Skye Games is a custom Minecraft server and community project that blends RPG mechanics, PvP battles, and creative building into one evolving world. It’s designed to feel like a mix of classic survival with modern game modes, offering players both progression and unique challenges.
